rationale: The workflow is a reusable Gradle-based Android build that repeatedly fetches dependencies. The measured experiment evidence (experiment:batch-interactive-three--91c08fe132959200, pattern P-LIT-GHA-CACHE) shows adding an explicit actions/cache step for ~/.gradle/caches after setup-gradle, keyed on gradle files and the wrapper properties, reduced median elapsed CI time by ~20.4% with all runs still succeeding. Preconditions are met: repeated dependency fetching occurs and the cache key includes lockfile/wrapper inputs. No contraindications apply: the cached content is standard Gradle dependency cache, no equivalent explicit actions/cache step already exists, and no new network access, secrets, privileged actions, or deployment operations are introduced. All existing build steps, required checks, and artifact outputs are preserved unchanged.
